concepts.name: Archived Repository (Analysis-Only)
concepts.summary: ORISO-Database is ARCHIVED upstream and frozen at June 2026. It was the interim central schema store while services ran with Liquibase disabled; canonical schema management has since moved back to per-service Liquibase changelogs in each service repository, with deployment/infra owned by ORISO-Helm. Treat everything here as a historical snapshot for analysis and forensics, not as a deployment source.

concepts.name: Central Schema Authority (historical model)
concepts.summary: The repository's original operating model: all backend services (TenantService, UserService, AgencyService, ConsultingTypeService) ran with Liquibase DISABLED and schemas were version-controlled and applied from here. This model is retired — the repo is archived and per-service Liquibase is being re-enabled service by service (environments still running SPRING_LIQUIBASE_ENABLED=false rely on Helm-shipped SQL baselines instead of service changelogs) — but the schema.sql exports remain useful as a point-in-time reference of the June 2026 database state (DATABASECHANGELOG tables are still present in every dump).

concepts.name: MariaDB Schemas (7 databases, June 2026 snapshot)
concepts.summary: Per-service mysqldump exports for agencyservice, consultingtypeservice, tenantservice, userservice, videoservice, uploadservice, and the empty shared caritas database. The userservice snapshot (27 tables) already includes the case handover subsystem (case_handover_request, case_handover_reason_policy), event_notification, appointment, draft_message, and identity_tombstone; the tenantservice snapshot includes the address/description columns added in June 2026.

concepts.name: Matrix Migration Dual-Column Snapshot
concepts.summary: The userservice schema is frozen mid-migration: user, consultant, session, and chat tables carry BOTH legacy RocketChat columns (rc_user_id, rc_group_id) AND Matrix columns (matrix_user_id, matrix_room_id, matrix_password). The live platform has since completed the Matrix-only migration; this dump documents the transitional shape only. Matrix Synapse's own PostgreSQL schema was never captured (see postgresql/matrix/STATUS.md).

concepts.name: Polyglot Stores (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis)
concepts.summary: Beyond MariaDB: MongoDB BSON dumps of consulting types and application settings (duplicated under consulting_types/ and consultingtypeservice/), a PostgreSQL status doc for Matrix Synapse (pod was never reachable, schema never exported), plus RabbitMQ and Redis operational notes — each store has its own README.

concepts.name: Incident DB-C03 Remediation & Secret Management
concepts.summary: docs/incident-2026-02/db-c03-remediation.md records the remediation of the February 2026 credential exposure: plaintext system-user passwords were removed from scripts/system-users-job.yaml, matrixRegistrationSecret moved from ConfigMap into the system-users-credentials Kubernetes Secret, and SQL quote-escaping added. docs/secret-management.md defines the Secret contract (SealedSecret/SOPS/ESO) and rotation follow-ups.

concepts.name: In-Cluster MariaDB Client
concepts.summary: k8s/mariadb-client provides a kustomize-deployed database client (deployment, service, ingress, configmap) for admin access to MariaDB inside the cluster. Legacy operational tooling — with the repo archived, current in-cluster tooling is owned by ORISO-Helm.

flows.name: New Environment Initialization (legacy)
flows.summary: Historical bootstrap path: scripts/database-initialize.yaml provisions the databases → per-service schema.sql files create the tables → scripts/system-users-job.yaml creates system users (reading credentials from the system-users-credentials Secret and writing Matrix credentials into userservice); MongoDB collections restored from the tracked BSON dumps. Superseded by ORISO-Helm charts plus per-service Liquibase for current environments.

flows.name: SQL Escaping Test
flows.summary: tests/test-sql-escaping.sh validates the single-quote escaping used when interpolating secret values into the system-users MariaDB heredoc — added as part of the DB-C03 remediation.
